product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global provides international and domestic freight transportation, customs brokerage, and trade-advisory services to businesses managing complex supply chains.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as a supply-chain and trade-services provider; homepage lists international, North American transportation, and trade-advisor services.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation and footer include service, resource, and contact links but no pricing link or public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both are named as customer companies in Mohawk Global case studies.

hq_location.notes: The company identifies Syracuse, New York as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company About page says it was founded in 1993.

eng_blog.notes: The Knowledge Center contains trade, market, global-news, white-paper, and case-study content; it does not show an engineering blog with technical posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public help resources include multiple guides and FAQs (including ACE/CAPE FAQs and an ACE Secure Data Portal Guide), accessible through the Knowledge Center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Mohawk Global directs candidates to an open job board. The available listing reviewed included an Account Executive role, not an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The product and public privacy/security information reviewed do not name an AI model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy page discusses information safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

last_funding.notes: Mohawk describes itself as family-owned and operated; the company profile reviewed disclosed no outside funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding round was identified; the company describes itself as family-owned and operated.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job-board information showed an Account Executive (International) opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch-type announcement found was the MGCX service expansion dated December 4, 2025, before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete executive-team page lists current C-level and VP-level leaders; no join or departure within the 12-month window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Mohawk Global page is explicitly titled “Salesforce Test 2,” providing a visible signal of Salesforce use.
